messages:
Cassie (Finance): Quick update — new expedited vendor/expense pathway goes live Mon Apr 6. TL;DR: purchases <= $25,000 can use the "Quick Vendor" flow with automatic virtual card issuance. Procurement review only for > $25k or flagged vendors. Docs: https://redwood.notion.so/procurement/quick-vendor-pathway
Ravi Patel: Nice. Is the $25k cap per PO or per vendor per year?
Cassie (Finance): Per PO. If groups want annual vendor limits, submit the vendor to the whitelist and we'll set a committed spend flag.
Ben L.: Does this change the receipt timeline? Last month we got flagged for late receipts.
Cassie (Finance): Yes — reminder: attach receipts within 7 days for virtual-card charges to avoid auto-pending. We added a browser + mobile upload link in the doc.
Jules Nguyen: Any change to who signs off on professional services? (we have a long-term vendor)
Cassie (Finance): Long-running SOWs > $25k still need Procurement + Legal signoff. For repeat subs under $25k, use the Quick Vendor and pick the existing vendor from the dropdown.
Maya Chen: Will finance auto-approve common SaaS vendors (e.g., Segment, Sentry) or do we need to request it?
Procurement Bot: Automated check: Segment, Sentry, Rollbar — candidates for "auto-trusted". Submit a request via /vendor-whitelist if you'd like us to add a vendor. Link: https://redwood.services/proc-whitelist
Ravi Patel: ok thanks — cc @Cassie
Ben L.: :thumbsup:
Cassie (Finance): FYI: exceptions still allowed — use the exception form in the doc. For anything urgent, ping #finance and include PO amount + vendor URL. We'll aim <24h turnaround on expedited requests.
Jules Nguyen: Love the faster flow. Can we get a small training/AMA next Wed?
Cassie (Finance): Yep — 30m AMA scheduled Wed Apr 8 @ 3pm PT. Invite sent.
Procurement Bot: Reminder scheduled: AMA event invite -> accepted by 18 members.
Maya Chen: Thanks! I'll bring the product team's common vendor list.
Cassie (Finance): Thanks team — please read the doc before the AMA. If you're a manager, forward to your ICs who submit spend.
